network_status.network: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti descrivono le piogge torrenziali del 12-13 gennaio 2009 e il danneggiamento o cedimento del ponte sul Marro, ma non riportano una misura idrometrica del torrente. ARCUS non converte il contesto pluviometrico in livello o portata.
network_status.summary_en: The sources describe torrential rainfall on 12-13 January 2009 and damage or failure of the Marro bridge but report no stream-gauge measurement. ARCUS does not convert rainfall context into stage or discharge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
